summary: Result Selection now opens from its own saved files and refreshes persisted source and Ratio Basis values when upstream datasets change.
details: Current methods no longer reopen every source and Ratio Basis dataset during normal loading.
All configured Ratio Basis vectors are stored in the method JSON so statistics render without reopening basis files.
Legacy methods are upgraded once, and failed dependency refreshes preserve the last valid saved result for review.
Automatic refresh now continues through independent successful branches, keeps stale method-owned branches in review, and blocks saving while a live dependency preview is being restored.
Open Result Selection pages coalesce matching clear/update notifications, preserve failed local restores for retry, and prevent save or sync responses from superseding newer dependency updates.
